//: cleanUrls is deliberately OFF. Every link in this app points at an
explicit .html file, and turning it on made Vercel 308-redirect
/login.html -> /login while the redirect rule below sent /login ->
/login.html: an infinite loop that broke the deployed site.
Caching is deliberately conservative. Filenames are NOT content-hashed
(there is no build step), so an immutable long-lived cache would pin
visitors to whatever version they first loaded and no redeploy could
ever reach them. must-revalidate lets the browser keep the file but
check with an ETag first, which costs one cheap 304 and stays correct.
